title: Comunicado 2026-05-07
summary: Banxico cut 25bp to 6.50% by a 3-2 majority (Rodriguez, Cuadra and Mejia for; Borja and Heath dissenting to hold at 6.75%), but explicitly framed the move as the one that concludes the cycle begun in March 2024 and guided that holding the rate at its current level will be appropriate going forward, judging the stance adequate even for a prolonged Middle East conflict. The cut leaned on the stronger peso, a Q1 activity contraction with wider-than-expected slack and important downside risks, and the restriction already in place, while headline and core inflation eased and no second-round effects from the year-start tax measures appeared. The brakes are on the inflation side: 2026 expectations rose, Q2-Q3 headline forecasts were revised up on non-core, and the risk balance stays tilted to the upside. Versus the March communique, which resumed cutting and left further easing on the table, the action is the same but the guidance flips from continuing the cycle to an explicit end of easing and a hold ahead, with the Board still split 3-2; the scale reads it as a last cut with a pause ahead, pulled up by the two dissents.

key_quotes.quote: La Junta de Gobierno juzgó apropiado realizar un recorte adicional a la tasa de referencia y con esto concluir el ciclo iniciado en marzo de 2024.
key_quotes.context: The 25bp cut is framed as the final move of the easing cycle

key_quotes.quote: Hacia delante la Junta de Gobierno considera que será apropiado mantener la tasa de referencia en su nivel actual.
key_quotes.context: Explicit hold guidance after the cut, replacing March's open-ended continuation of the cycle

key_quotes.quote: Votaron a favor de mantener el objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día en un nivel de 6.75% Galia Borja Gómez y Jonathan Heath.
key_quotes.context: Two of five members dissent for a hold, the same 3-2 split as March

key_quotes.quote: Se considera que el balance de riesgos respecto de la trayectoria prevista para la inflación en el horizonte de pronóstico mantiene un sesgo al alza.
key_quotes.context: Upside-tilted inflation risk balance, with 2026 expectations and Q2-Q3 forecasts up, the rationale for stopping
